native_semantics: If actor+0x50 has bit 0x40000000, return null before reading or detaching actor+0x60.
If actor+0x60 is nonnull, call detach_child(actor) before reading live coordinates.
Read z at +0x08, y at +0x04, then x at +0x00; call spawn_kind(x,y,z,(WORD)action).
If the factory returns null, return null and retain any completed detach effects.
On success, store child+0x50=0x10000000; read parent+0x54, OR 0x00800000, store parent+0x60=child then parent+0x54; copy parent WORD+0x38 then byte+0x22 to child.
